thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT fired: inference-queue.backlog HIGH — queue depth 14k, avg latency 1200ms, autoscaler_unhappy=true

pagerduty: PagerDuty: page triggered for service 'inference-queue' (severity: P1). Assigned to sarah-oncall.

sarah-oncall: acked via PD, looking now. any customer hits?

jay-eng: seeing spike in token ingestion from a customer beta key, approx 3x baseline. some 503s in logs.

sarah-oncall: confirm 503s in frontend logs: `503 backpressure` around 14:11-14:18, trending. marking impact: intermittent errors for some requests.

mike-sre: autoscaler metrics show desired_replicas=120 but actual_nodes=48 and pending_provision=0. cloud provider quota error in the controller logs.

sarah-oncall: copy. can we manual scale as a stopgap? thoughts about eviction/overprovision?

jay-eng: manual scale to 140 would help short-term. but provider API is returning `QuotaExceeded: Cannot create more instances`. stack traces: ```kube-controller-manager autoscaler: failed to provision nodes: QuotaExceeded: vCPU limit reached```

mike-sre: opened ticket with cloud quota team (INC-1142). They estimate 30min to approve increase. launching warm nodepool with smaller instance type as workaround.

sarah-oncall: performing manual patch to deployment to increase burst capacity to 60% (temp). running: `kubectl patch hpa autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":200}}'`

jay-eng: patched. also enabling short-lived prefix caching to cut load on runtime: `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_PREFIX_CACHE=enabled ttl=30s` — pushing config to canary.

sarah-oncall: monitoring. queue depth dropping slowly 14k -> 9.2k in 6m. latency down to ~700ms. still seeing 5-7% 503s.

mike-sre: cloud team approved partial quota bump (vCPUs +80) — provisioning in progress. nodepool warmup ETA ~8m.

olivia-nextoncall: looping in next oncall for handoff in 20m. please add notes about customer impact and mitigation steps.

sarah-oncall: will handoff a short runbook: 1) check `kubectl get hpa/autoscaler` and `kubectl get nodes` 2) if desired_replicas>actual and pending_provision=0, open cloud quota ticket + fallback to smaller instance pool 3) enable prefix cache override if latency >500ms 4) escalate to cloud infra if quota not rising in 15m

jay-eng: customer-impact note: one enterprise customer reported degraded responses — sent them a status DM and set to 'throttled/beta' flag to reduce ingestion.

sarah-oncall: paging to be closed when queue <1k and 99th latency <300ms for 10m. currently at 6k and 99th=420ms. continuing watches. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded by sarah-oncall at 14:23:12.

mike-sre: nodepool warm completed, actual_nodes=132, desired_replicas satisfied. autoscaler back to healthy. metrics show queue dropping to 800 in last 9m.

sarah-oncall: great. lowering severity to P2 in PD, keeping channel open for handoff. prepping final notes for postmortem.

olivia-nextoncall: thanks all — I'll take 1st line in morning. leaving notes in INC-1143 with timestamps and commands used. good job team. :raised_hands:
